title: Automated fidelity sampler for version pinning and tenant upgrades
creator: Maya Chen
description: Introduce an automated 'fidelity sampler' that kicks off targeted eval workloads when model versions are pinned or upgraded in both catalog-level and customer-pinned workflows. The sampler will select representative prompt subsets using workload-aware heuristics, run a lightweight smoke pass for fast detection and a staged full-fidelity pass for higher confidence, and enqueue results into the eval orchestration service. Goals: surface regressions within minutes for high-risk pins, avoid noisy false positives by contextualizing against baseline metrics, and enable automated guardrail actions (alerts, canary holds, rollbacks) configurable per-tenant or catalog entry.
acceptance_criteria: Sampler triggers automatically on catalog pin and customer pin events for supported model types
Two-tier execution: fast smoke (<=5m median) and full-fidelity (configurable SLA) are implemented
Sampling heuristic uses tenant traffic profile and historical failure modes to pick prioritized prompt buckets
Results are persisted and visible in Console eval tab with diffed metrics vs pinned baseline
Configurable thresholds produce actionable signals: notice, block-canary, auto-rollback
Webhook notifications and Slack alerts emitted with clear triage links
Operational cost budget guardrails prevent runaway evals for large customers
tasks: PM: finalize sampling policy and risk tiers
Design: mock Console UI for per-pin eval status and results drilldown
Eng: implement event hook in pin service to publish standardized pin-change events
Eng: build sampler service that consumes events, computes prompt sample, and submits to eval runner
Eng: add two execution profiles to eval runner (smoke, full-fidelity) and priority queue support
Infra: quota/enforcement for eval CPU/GPU and tenant budgets
SRE: create dashboards for sampler health and regression rate
QA: synthetic test matrix to validate detection + non-regression on benign pins
